title: 医疗与问诊精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我喉咙痛了三天，吞咽时尤其明显。
items.en: I've had a sore throat for three days, especially when I swallow.
answers: I've had a sore throat for three days, especially when I swallow.
I have had a sore throat for three days, especially when I swallow.
items.notes: have had 配合 for 描述持续症状；a sore throat 表示喉咙痛。

items.zh: 疼痛是突然开始的，还是逐渐加重的？
items.en: Did the pain start suddenly, or did it gradually get worse?
answers: Did the pain start suddenly, or did it gradually get worse?
items.notes: 两个过去时疑问句并列；get worse 表示变得更严重。

items.zh: 我以前服用这种药时出过皮疹。
items.en: I developed a rash when I took this medicine before.
answers: I developed a rash when I took this medicine before.
items.notes: develop a rash 表示出现皮疹；when 从句提供既往用药情境。

items.zh: 这项检查需要空腹做吗？
items.en: Do I need to fast before this test?
answers: Do I need to fast before this test?
items.notes: fast 在此作动词，指禁食；此句向医护确认要求，并非给出医疗建议。

items.zh: 您能把服药说明写下来，让我回家后可以再看吗？
items.en: Could you write down the instructions so that I can check them again at home?
answers: Could you write down the instructions so that I can check them again at home?
items.notes: so that 引导目的从句；write down 表示记下。

items.zh: 自从换了药，我晚上就很难入睡。
items.en: Since changing medication, I've had trouble falling asleep at night.
answers: Since changing medication, I've had trouble falling asleep at night.
Since changing medication, I have had trouble falling asleep at night.
items.notes: have trouble doing 表示做某事有困难；since changing 的逻辑主语是 I。

items.zh: 如果我漏服了一次，应该联系谁询问该怎么处理？
items.en: Who should I contact for advice if I miss a dose?
answers: Who should I contact for advice if I miss a dose?
items.notes: miss a dose 指漏服一次；contact 是及物动词，后面不加 with。

items.zh: 我想预约复诊，最好在下周一下午。
items.en: I'd like to book a follow-up appointment, preferably next Monday afternoon.
answers: I'd like to book a follow-up appointment, preferably next Monday afternoon.
I would like to book a follow-up appointment, preferably next Monday afternoon.
items.notes: follow-up appointment 指复诊预约；preferably 表示最好。

items.zh: 让我担心的是，这次头痛和以前的不一样。
items.en: What worries me is that this headache feels different from the ones I've had before.
answers: What worries me is that this headache feels different from the ones I've had before.
What worries me is that this headache feels different from the ones I have had before.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；ones 代指以前的头痛，避免重复。

items.zh: 您说的副作用包括嗜睡吗？
items.en: Does the side effect you mentioned include drowsiness?
answers: Does the side effect you mentioned include drowsiness?
items.notes: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 side effect；drowsiness 表示嗜睡、困倦。

items.zh: 在我同意这项操作之前，您能解释一下有哪些替代方案吗？
items.en: Before I consent to this procedure, could you explain what alternatives are available?
answers: Before I consent to this procedure, could you explain what alternatives are available?
items.notes: consent to 后接名词；what 从句使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 我走上楼梯时会气短，但休息后会好一些。
items.en: I get short of breath when I climb stairs, but it improves after I rest.
answers: I get short of breath when I climb stairs, but it improves after I rest.
items.notes: get short of breath 表示气短；描述诱因与缓解情况，不自行推断病因。

items.zh: 我左耳听起来像被堵住了。
items.en: My left ear feels blocked.
answers: My left ear feels blocked.
items.notes: blocked：堵塞的感觉。

items.zh: 这处肿胀是昨天晚上才出现的。
items.en: This swelling appeared only last night.
answers: This swelling appeared only last night.
items.notes: swelling：肿胀。

items.zh: 我能指出疼痛最明显的位置。
items.en: I can point to where the pain is strongest.
answers: I can point to where the pain is strongest.
items.notes: point to：指向。

items.zh: 疼痛会延伸到肩膀，还是只在脖子周围？
items.en: Does the pain extend to the shoulder or stay around the neck?
answers: Does the pain extend to the shoulder or stay around the neck?
items.notes: extend to：延伸到。

items.zh: 这种不适每次持续大约十分钟。
items.en: The discomfort lasts about ten minutes each time.
answers: The discomfort lasts about ten minutes each time.
items.notes: last 作动词表示持续。

items.zh: 我最近没有受伤，也没有更换日常活动。
items.en: I have not had an injury or changed my usual activities recently.
answers: I have not had an injury or changed my usual activities recently.
I've not had an injury or changed my usual activities recently.
items.notes: 否定句中的 or 并列两项。

items.zh: 我带来了目前正在服用的药物清单。
items.en: I have brought a list of the medicines I am currently taking.
answers: I have brought a list of the medicines I am currently taking.
I've brought a list of the medicines I'm currently taking.
items.notes: take medicine：服药。

items.zh: 这包括我自己购买的非处方药。
items.en: This includes the over-the-counter medicines I bought myself.
answers: This includes the over-the-counter medicines I bought myself.
items.notes: over-the-counter：非处方的。

items.zh: 您需要知道我上次接种疫苗的日期吗？
items.en: Do you need the date of my most recent vaccination?
answers: Do you need the date of my most recent vaccination?
items.notes: vaccination：疫苗接种。

items.zh: 我不确定家里是否有人有过类似症状。
items.en: I am not sure whether anyone in my family has had similar symptoms.
answers: I am not sure whether anyone in my family has had similar symptoms.
I'm not sure whether anyone in my family has had similar symptoms.
items.notes: whether：是否。

items.zh: 检查结果会通过电话通知，还是发到线上账户？
items.en: Will the results be given by phone or sent to my online account?
answers: Will the results be given by phone or sent to my online account?
items.notes: 两个被动谓语共用 will be。

items.zh: 如果结果迟迟没有出来，我应该联系哪个部门？
items.en: Which department should I contact if the results are delayed?
answers: Which department should I contact if the results are delayed?
items.notes: delayed：延迟的。

items.zh: 我需要请一天假做检查，能开就诊证明吗？
items.en: I need a day off for the test; could I have proof of attendance?
answers: I need a day off for the test; could I have proof of attendance?
items.notes: proof of attendance：就诊到场证明。

items.zh: 这次预约是否包括与医生讨论结果的时间？
items.en: Does this appointment include time to discuss the results with the doctor?
answers: Does this appointment include time to discuss the results with the doctor?
items.notes: time to do：做某事的时间。

items.zh: 我希望有人陪同就诊，需要提前登记吗？
items.en: I would like someone to accompany me; do they need to register in advance?
answers: I would like someone to accompany me; do they need to register in advance?
I'd like someone to accompany me; do they need to register in advance?
items.notes: accompany：陪同。

items.zh: 您能用更简单的话解释这个术语吗？
items.en: Could you explain this term in simpler language?
answers: Could you explain this term in simpler language?
items.notes: in simpler language：用更简单的语言。

items.zh: 我想确认自己是否正确理解了下一步安排。
items.en: I would like to check that I have understood the next steps correctly.
answers: I would like to check that I have understood the next steps correctly.
I'd like to check that I have understood the next steps correctly.
items.notes: check that：核对某理解。

items.zh: 这次治疗需要几次后续预约？
items.en: How many follow-up visits does this treatment involve?
answers: How many follow-up visits does this treatment involve?
items.notes: involve：涉及、需要。

items.zh: 如果症状发生变化，应该通过什么渠道联系诊所？
items.en: How should I contact the clinic if my symptoms change?
answers: How should I contact the clinic if my symptoms change?
items.notes: if 引出需要联系的情况。

items.zh: 我记下了症状出现时正在做的事情。
items.en: I noted what I was doing when the symptoms appeared.
answers: I noted what I was doing when the symptoms appeared.
items.notes: 过去进行时描述当时活动。

items.zh: 这个伤口接触衣服时会疼。
items.en: The wound hurts when it touches my clothing.
answers: The wound hurts when it touches my clothing.
items.notes: hurt 可作不及物动词。

items.zh: 我的视力有时模糊，但并不是一直如此。
items.en: My vision is sometimes blurred, but not all the time.
answers: My vision is sometimes blurred, but not all the time.
items.notes: not all the time：并非一直。

items.zh: 我想了解这次转诊的原因和预约方式。
items.en: I would like to understand the reason for this referral and how to book it.
answers: I would like to understand the reason for this referral and how to book it.
I'd like to understand the reason for this referral and how to book it.
items.notes: referral：转诊。

items.zh: 费用估算中是否包含化验室收费？
items.en: Does the cost estimate include laboratory fees?
answers: Does the cost estimate include laboratory fees?
items.notes: cost estimate：费用预估。
